Diff old vs new option-handling output

result:
Changed: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `lib/common.sh` (new), `tests/run_tests.sh` — all 11 tests pass (`bash tests/run_tests.sh`).

Details behind that:
- `rotate.sh`: the early exit was `-lt` (so exactly N fell through to deletion) and `surplus()` used `tail -n +"$keep"`, which cut from the *newest* end. Now `-le` and `head -n "$((total - keep))"`, so it deletes the oldest surplus and keeps the newest N.
- `verify.sh`: `awk '{print $2}'` truncated the sidecar's file name at the first space, and `[ $expected == $actual ]` word-split. It now splits the line at the first whitespace, keeps the remainder as the name, and quotes the comparison.
- `lib/common.sh`: the option-parsing block and `resolve_dir` moved there verbatim, sourced by `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh` (`source .../lib/common.sh "$@"`); the other three scripts are untouched.
- Verified the new tests fail against the pre-fix code (`rotate --keep 3` deleted `demo-20260103-000000.tar.gz`, the newest; `verify` reported `BAD my (archive missing)`), and diffed old-vs-new behavior across 28 flag/exit-code cases (`--help`, `--keep=abc`, `-q`, `-n`, `--`, relative `--dest`, unknown flags) — identical apart from the intended rotation fix.

Scratch files for the comparisons are in `/tmp/base-check`; removing them needs your approval since it's outside the repo.
